cardMenu.play.description: Menu row on Roku, in the Options menu of a focused poster card. Starts playback of the item from the beginning.

cardMenu.resume.description: Menu row on Roku, in the Options menu of a focused poster card. Continues playback of a partly watched item where it stopped.

cardMenu.addWatchlist.description: Menu row on Roku, in the Options menu of a focused poster card. Saves the item to the user's Watchlist.

cardMenu.removeContinueWatching.description: Menu row on Roku, in the Options menu of a card in the Continue Watching row. Removes the item from that row.

cardMenu.removeNextUp.description: Menu row on Roku, in the Options menu of a card in the Next Up row. Removes the item from that row.

requests.yourRequests.description: Heading of the row of the user's own media requests on the Roku Requests screen.

requests.myRequests.description: Title of the Roku screen listing all of the user's media requests, opened from the See all link.

requests.seeAll.description: Short link at the end of the requests row on Roku that opens the full list of the user's requests.

requests.loading.description: Loading message on the Roku Requests screen while the user's media requests are fetched.

requests.empty.description: Heading of the empty state on the Roku Requests screen when the user has made no requests.

requests.emptyBody.description: Body text of the empty state on the Roku Requests screen. Tells the user to use the Search screen to find a title to request.

requests.mediaType.movie.description: Label on a request card on Roku saying the requested title is a movie.

requests.mediaType.series.description: Label on a request card on Roku saying the requested title is a TV series.

requests.requestedOn.description: Info line on a request card on Roku. {date}: the short date the request was made, such as Mar 5.

requests.createdBy.description: Line on a Roku request detail or card naming who made the request. {names}: comma-separated names of the requesting users.

requests.moreLikeThis.description: Heading of the row of similar titles at the bottom of the Roku request detail screen.

requests.searchScope.description: Label of the search filter segment on Roku that limits results to titles that can be requested from the server.

requests.searchEmptyBody.description: Message on the Roku Search screen when the Request filter is chosen and no requestable titles match the query.

requests.date.description: Short date on a Roku request, combining month and day in the locale's order. {month}: the abbreviated month name, such as Mar; {day}: the day of the month number.

requests.month.1.description: Abbreviated name of January, used in the short request date on Roku (for example in the date a request was made).

requests.month.2.description: Abbreviated name of February, used in the short request date on Roku (for example in the date a request was made).

requests.month.3.description: Abbreviated name of March, used in the short request date on Roku (for example in the date a request was made).

requests.month.4.description: Abbreviated name of April, used in the short request date on Roku (for example in the date a request was made).

requests.month.5.description: Abbreviated name of May, used in the short request date on Roku (for example in the date a request was made).

requests.month.6.description: Abbreviated name of June, used in the short request date on Roku (for example in the date a request was made).

requests.month.7.description: Abbreviated name of July, used in the short request date on Roku (for example in the date a request was made).

requests.month.8.description: Abbreviated name of August, used in the short request date on Roku (for example in the date a request was made).

requests.month.9.description: Abbreviated name of September, used in the short request date on Roku (for example in the date a request was made).

requests.month.10.description: Abbreviated name of October, used in the short request date on Roku (for example in the date a request was made).

requests.month.11.description: Abbreviated name of November, used in the short request date on Roku (for example in the date a request was made).

requests.month.12.description: Abbreviated name of December, used in the short request date on Roku (for example in the date a request was made).

requests.short.pending.description: Short status label on a Roku request card: the request is waiting for an admin to approve it.

requests.short.partly.description: Short status label on a Roku request card: only some of the requested episodes or seasons are in the library.

requests.short.downloading.description: Short status label on a Roku request card: the requested title is currently being downloaded.

requests.short.adding.description: Short status label on a Roku request card: the downloaded title is being added to the library.

requests.short.queued.description: Short status label on a Roku request card: the request is queued and download has not started.

requests.short.onTheWay.description: Short status label on a Roku request card: approved and on its way to the library.

requests.short.inLibrary.description: Short status label on a Roku request card: the requested title is now in the library.

requests.short.declined.description: Short status label on a Roku request card: an admin declined the request.

requests.short.failed.description: Short status label on a Roku request card: the request failed.

requests.short.unavailable.description: Short status label on a Roku request card: the title cannot be requested or its status is unknown.

requests.long.pending.description: Longer status text on the Roku request detail screen: the request is waiting for approval.

requests.long.partly.description: Longer status text on the Roku request detail screen: only part of the title is in the user's library.

requests.long.downloading.description: Longer status text on the Roku request detail screen: the title is being downloaded.

requests.long.adding.description: Longer status text on the Roku request detail screen: the title is being added to the library.

requests.long.queued.description: Longer status text on the Roku request detail screen: the title is queued for download.

requests.long.onTheWay.description: Longer status text on the Roku request detail screen: the approved title is on its way to the library.

requests.long.inLibrary.description: Longer status text on the Roku request detail screen: the title is in the user's library.

requests.long.declined.description: Longer status text on the Roku request detail screen: the request was declined.

requests.long.failed.description: Longer status text on the Roku request detail screen: the request failed.

requests.detailTitle.pending.description: Title at the top of the Roku request detail screen for a request still awaiting approval. The dot separates the two parts.

requests.detailTitle.onTheWay.description: Title at the top of the Roku request detail screen for an approved request that is on its way to the library.

requests.detailTitle.inLibrary.description: Title at the top of the Roku request detail screen when the requested title is in the library.

requests.detailTitle.declined.description: Title at the top of the Roku request detail screen for a declined request. A reason may follow after a separator.

requests.detailTitle.failed.description: Title at the top of the Roku request detail screen when the request failed.

requests.detailTitle.unavailable.description: Title at the top of the Roku request detail screen when the title cannot be requested or its status is unknown.

requests.reason.already_requested.description: Reason shown on the Roku request detail screen: someone has already requested this title.

requests.reason.already_available.description: Reason shown on the Roku request detail screen: the title is already in the user's library, so it cannot be requested.

requests.reason.quota_exceeded.description: Reason shown on the Roku request detail screen: the user has used up their allowed number of requests.

requests.reason.requests_disabled.description: Reason shown on the Roku request detail screen: the server has turned off media requests.

requests.reason.blocked.description: Reason shown on the Roku request detail screen: the user is currently blocked from making requests.

requests.reason.validation_failed.description: Reason shown on Roku when the server rejected a request as invalid.

requests.reason.invalid_state.description: Reason shown on Roku when the request has progressed too far to be cancelled or changed.

requests.reason.not_found.description: Reason shown on Roku when the requested title no longer exists on the server or the request source.

requests.reason.request_unconfirmed.description: Status reason on the Roku request detail screen: the app could not confirm that the request went through.

requests.action.request.description: Button on the Roku request detail screen that asks the server to add this title.

requests.action.requestAgain.description: Button on the Roku request detail screen shown after a declined or failed request, to submit it again.

requests.action.requesting.description: Button label on the Roku request detail screen while a request is being submitted.

requests.action.openInLibrary.description: Button on the Roku request detail screen that opens the title in the library once it is available.

requests.action.notify.description: Button on the Roku request detail screen to be notified when the requested title becomes available.

requests.action.stopNotify.description: Button on the Roku request detail screen to turn off the availability notification for this title.

requests.action.cancel.description: Button or menu option on Roku that cancels the user's pending request.

requests.notice.following.description: Toast on Roku after the user turns on notifications for a request. Promises a notice when the title is available.

requests.notice.unfollowed.description: Toast on Roku confirming the availability notification for a request was turned off.

requests.notice.unconfirmedCreate.description: Toast on Roku when the app could not confirm a new request went through. My Requests is the screen listing the user's requests.

requests.notice.unconfirmedCancel.description: Toast on Roku when the app could not confirm a request was cancelled. My Requests is the screen listing the user's requests.

requests.error.create.description: Error toast on Roku when submitting a new media request fails.

requests.error.cancel.description: Error toast on Roku when cancelling a media request fails.

requests.error.follow.description: Error toast on Roku when turning the availability notification for a request on or off fails.

requests.error.network.description: Error toast on Roku when the server cannot be reached while handling a request.

requests.error.permission.description: Error toast on Roku when the user lacks permission for a request action. Suggests asking the server admin.

requests.error.load.description: Generic error heading on the Roku Requests screens when loading fails.

requests.error.missing.description: Error on the Roku request detail screen when the requested title can no longer be found.

requests.strip.status.description: Column heading, in capitals, of the status strip on the Roku request detail screen, above the request's current status.

requests.strip.requested.description: Column heading, in capitals, of the status strip on the Roku request detail screen, above the date or person who made the request.

requests.strip.quality.description: Column heading, in capitals, of the status strip on the Roku request detail screen, above the requested video quality.

requests.stage.requested.description: Label under the first segment of the four-step progress bar on the Roku request detail screen: the request was made.

requests.stage.approved.description: Label under the second segment of the four-step progress bar on the Roku request detail screen: the request was approved.

requests.stage.downloading.description: Label under the third segment of the four-step progress bar on the Roku request detail screen: the title is downloading.

requests.stage.library.description: Label under the last segment of the four-step progress bar on the Roku request detail screen: the title is in the library.

subtitleSearch.title.description: Title of the subtitle search panel in the Roku video player options, where the user finds subtitles online.

subtitleSearch.explainer.description: Intro text in the Roku subtitle search panel above the language list. Tells the user to pick a language.

subtitleSearch.searchingIn.description: Progress heading in the Roku subtitle search panel while a search runs. {language}: the language name being searched, such as French.

subtitleSearch.searching.description: Progress message in the Roku subtitle search panel while subtitle providers (online services) are queried.

subtitleSearch.searchingNote.description: Note under the progress message in the Roku subtitle search panel, warning that the search may be slow.

subtitleSearch.resultCount.description: Heading above the results in the Roku subtitle search panel. {language}: the language name, such as French; {count}: the number of subtitles found.

subtitleSearch.failedTitle.description: Heading in the Roku subtitle search panel when a search fails.

subtitleSearch.preferredHeader.description: Section header in the Roku subtitle search language list, above the user's preferred subtitle language.

subtitleSearch.allHeader.description: Section header in the Roku subtitle search language list, above every available language.

subtitleSearch.languageHeader.description: Header in the Roku subtitle search panel for the language choice.

subtitleSearch.preferred.description: Small tag on a language row in the Roku subtitle search panel marking the user's preferred language.

subtitleSearch.chooseAnother.description: Button in the Roku subtitle search panel that goes back to the language list to try a different language.

subtitleSearch.noResults.description: Message in the Roku subtitle search panel when nothing was found. {language}: the language name that was searched.

subtitleSearch.untitled.description: Placeholder name for a subtitle result in the Roku search panel that has no release name.

subtitleSearch.downloads.description: Detail on a subtitle result row in the Roku search panel. {count}: how many times the subtitle has been downloaded.

subtitleSearch.match.description: Detail on a subtitle result row in the Roku search panel. {score}: how closely the subtitle matches this video, as a number out of 100.

subtitleSearch.hearingImpaired.description: Very short tag on a subtitle result row in the Roku search panel. Abbreviation for subtitles made for deaf or hard-of-hearing viewers.

subtitleSearch.selectHint.description: Hint at the foot of the Roku subtitle search results, telling the user that selecting a result downloads and applies it.

subtitleSearch.adding.description: Progress message in the Roku subtitle search panel while the chosen subtitle is downloaded and added.

subtitleSearch.notSetUp.description: Message in the Roku subtitle search panel when the server has no subtitle search provider configured.

subtitleSearch.searchFailed.description: Error message in the Roku subtitle search panel when the search fails for an unspecific reason.

subtitleSearch.rateLimited.description: Error message in the Roku subtitle search panel when the online providers are throttling requests.

subtitleSearch.notAllowed.description: Error message in the Roku subtitle search panel when the server's rules or the user's permissions block subtitle downloads.

subtitleSearch.notFound.description: Error message in the Roku subtitle search panel when the chosen subtitle has disappeared from the provider.

subtitleSearch.downloadFailed.description: Error message in the Roku subtitle search panel when downloading the chosen subtitle fails.

subtitleSearch.stored.description: Message in the Roku player after a subtitle was downloaded but could not be switched on during this playback.

subtitleSearch.notTurnedOn.description: Message in the Roku player after a subtitle was downloaded but could not be switched on. Tracks and Subtitles are menu names in the player options.

subtitleSearch.unconfirmed.description: Message in the Roku player when the server did not confirm the subtitle download. Silo is the app name.
